{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= GUI

|eff= local

|descr= [[File:BIS_fnc_typeText2.gif|400px|right]]
Types a structured text on the screen, letter by letter, cursor blinking. Note that line returns are manual, unlike [[BIS_fnc_typeText]].

|s1= [stringLines, posX, posY, alignBottom, rootFormat, abortParams, abortCond, playSounds] call [[BIS_fnc_typeText2]]

|p1= stringLines:
* [[Array]] of [[String]]s - array containing lines of text with same structured text formatting.
* [[Array]] of [[Array]] of [[String]]s [text, format, color]
** text: [[String]] - (Optional, default <sqf inline>""</sqf>)
** format: [[String]] - (Optional, default <sqf inline>"align = 'center' size = '0.7'"</sqf>) a linebreak is defined as "&lt;br/&gt;" '''and this only!'''
** color: [[String]] - (Optional, default <sqf inline>"#ffffff"</sqf>)

|p2= posX: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0)

|p3= posY: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0)

|p4= alignBottom: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[true]])

|p5= rootFormat: [[String]] - (Optional, default <sqf inline>"<t>%1</t>"</sqf>)

|p6= abortParams: [[Array]] - (Optional, default <sqf inline>[]</sqf>)

|p7= abortCond: [[Code]] - (Optional, default <sqf inline>{ false }</sqf>)

|p8= playSounds: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[true]])

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>
[
	[
		["CAMP ROGAIN, ", "align = 'center' shadow = '1' size = '0.7' font='PuristaBold'"],
		["RESUPPLY POINT", "align = 'center' shadow = '1' size = '0.7'", "#aaaaaa"],
		["", "<br/>"], // line break
		["10 MINUTES LATER...", "align = 'center' shadow = '1' size = '1.0'"]
	]
] spawn BIS_fnc_typeText2;
</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
[
	["Hello there"],
	safeZoneX, safeZoneH / 2,
	true,
	"<t font='PuristaBold'>%1</t>",
	[],
	{ false },
	true
] spawn BIS_fnc_typeText2;
</sqf>

|exec= spawn

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_dynamicText]] [[BIS_fnc_infoText]] [[BIS_fnc_textTiles]] [[BIS_fnc_typeText]] [[BIS_fnc_EXP_camp_SITREP]]
}}
